newsitem.title: INDIA: India's NHB pays US$255 million to ANZ.
newsitem.headline: India's NHB pays US$255 million to ANZ.

text.p: India's National Housing Bank (NHB) on Thursday paid 9.12 billion rupees (US$255 million) to ANZ Grindlays Bank to comply with an arbitration panel ruling, NHB chairman P.P. Vora said.
In 1992, NHB, a subsidiary of the central bank Reserve Bank of India (RBI), issued nine crossed account payee only cheques favouring ANZ Grindlays, which ANZ credited to Mehta's account.
ANZ was told by the RBI to repay the money to NHB as it sought to unravel Mehta's dealings.

ANZ disputed NHB's claim, but agreed to comply with RBI's instruction subject to the case being referred to an arbitration panel. The panel ordered that NHB repay ANZ Grindlays 5.06 billion rupees, plus interest from 1992.
NHB is expected to appeal to higher courts.
